```{ojs}
// Helper functions for Beta distribution
function betaPDF(x, alpha, beta) {
  if (x <= 0 || x >= 1) return 0;
  // Using the log-gamma function for numerical stability
  const logBeta = lgamma(alpha) + lgamma(beta) - lgamma(alpha + beta);
  return Math.exp((alpha - 1) * Math.log(x) + (beta - 1) * Math.log(1 - x) - logBeta);
}

function lgamma(z) {
  const g = 7;
  const p = [0.99999999999980993, 676.5203681218851, -1259.1392167224028,
             771.32342877765313, -176.61502916214059, 12.507343278686905,
             -0.13857109526572012, 9.9843695780195716e-6, 1.5056327351493116e-7];
  
  if (z < 0.5) return Math.log(Math.PI) - Math.log(Math.sin(Math.PI * z)) - lgamma(1 - z);
  
  z -= 1;
  let x = p[0];
  for (let i = 1; i < g + 2; i++) x += p[i] / (z + i);
  
  const t = z + g + 0.5;
  return Math.log(2 * Math.PI) / 2 + (z + 0.5) * Math.log(t) - t + Math.log(x);
}

// Beta CDF using incomplete beta function (numerical approximation)
function betaCDF(x, alpha, beta) {
  if (x <= 0) return 0;
  if (x >= 1) return 1;
  
  // Use regularized incomplete beta function
  // For simplicity, using numerical integration
  const n = 1000;
  const h = x / n;
  let sum = 0;
  
  for (let i = 1; i < n; i++) {
    const t = i * h;
    sum += betaPDF(t, alpha, beta);
  }
  
  return h * (betaPDF(0, alpha, beta) / 2 + sum + betaPDF(x, alpha, beta) / 2);
}

// Inverse CDF using bisection method
function betaInvCDF(p, alpha, beta) {
  if (p <= 0) return 0;
  if (p >= 1) return 1;
  
  let low = 0, high = 1;
  const tol = 1e-6;
  
  while (high - low > tol) {
    const mid = (low + high) / 2;
    const cdf = betaCDF(mid, alpha, beta);
    
    if (cdf < p) {
      low = mid;
    } else {
      high = mid;
    }
  }
  
  return (low + high) / 2;
}
```

```{ojs}
// Generate intervals based on number of segments
function generateIntervals(nIntervals, targetProb, alpha, beta) {
  const intervals = [];
  const remainingProb = 1 - targetProb; // This is α
  
  if (nIntervals === 1) {
    // Single interval: use equal-tailed interval as default
    const tailProb = remainingProb / 2;
    intervals.push({
      start: betaInvCDF(tailProb, alpha, beta),
      end: betaInvCDF(1 - tailProb, alpha, beta),
      prob: targetProb
    });
  } else {
    // Multiple intervals: distribute probability evenly
    const probPerInterval = targetProb / nIntervals;
    const gapProb = remainingProb / (nIntervals + 1);
    
    let cumProb = gapProb;
    for (let i = 0; i < nIntervals; i++) {
      const start = betaInvCDF(cumProb, alpha, beta);
      cumProb += probPerInterval;
      const end = betaInvCDF(cumProb, alpha, beta);
      cumProb += gapProb;
      
      intervals.push({ start, end, prob: probPerInterval });
    }
  }
  
  return intervals;
}
```

```{ojs}
// Main visualization
{
  const width = 960;
  const height = 400;
  const marginTop = 40;
  const marginBottom = 60;
  const marginLeft = 60;
  const marginRight = 40;
  
  // Generate posterior PDF data
  const xDomain = [0, 1];
  const nPoints = 500;
  const xValues = d3.range(nPoints).map(i => i / (nPoints - 1));
  const pdfData = xValues.map(x => ({
    x: x,
    y: betaPDF(x, betaAlpha, betaBeta)
  }));
  
  // Generate intervals
  const intervals = generateIntervals(numIntervals, 1 - alphaLevel, betaAlpha, betaBeta);
  
  // Calculate actual total probability (for display)
  let totalProb = 0;
  intervals.forEach(interval => {
    const prob = betaCDF(interval.end, betaAlpha, betaBeta) - 
                  betaCDF(interval.start, betaAlpha, betaBeta);
    totalProb += prob;
  });
  
  // Create color scale for intervals
  const colors = [
    "var(--plot-series-1)",
    "var(--plot-series-2)",
    "var(--plot-series-3)",
    "var(--plot-series-4)",
    "var(--plot-series-1)",
    "var(--plot-series-2)",
    "var(--plot-series-3)",
    "var(--plot-series-4)",
    "var(--plot-series-1)",
    "var(--plot-series-2)",
    "var(--plot-series-3)",
    "var(--plot-series-4)",
  ];
  
  // Calculate mean and mode for display
  const posteriorMean = betaAlpha / (betaAlpha + betaBeta);
  const posteriorMode = betaAlpha > 1 && betaBeta > 1 
    ? (betaAlpha - 1) / (betaAlpha + betaBeta - 2)
    : posteriorMean;
  
  // Create the plot
  const plot = Plot.plot({
    width,
    height,
    marginTop,
    marginBottom,
    marginLeft,
    marginRight,
    style: {
      background: "var(--plot-bg)",
      color: "var(--plot-fg)",
      fontFamily: bodyFont,
      fontSize: 14
    },
    x: {
      label: "θ",
      domain: xDomain,
      grid: false
    },
    y: {
      label: "Posterior density π(θ|x)",
      domain: [0, Math.max(...pdfData.map(d => d.y)) * 1.1]
    },
    marks: [
      // Grid baseline
      Plot.ruleY([0], { stroke: "var(--plot-grid)", strokeOpacity: 0.6 }),
      
      // Posterior PDF curve
      Plot.lineY(pdfData, { 
        x: "x", 
        y: "y", 
        stroke: "currentColor", 
        strokeWidth: 2,
        strokeOpacity: 0.9
      }),
      
      // Credible intervals (filled areas)
      ...intervals.map((interval, i) => {
        const intervalData = pdfData.filter(d => 
          d.x >= interval.start && d.x <= interval.end
        );
        return Plot.areaY(intervalData, {
          x: "x",
          y: "y",
          fill: colors[i % colors.length],
          fillOpacity: 0.3,
        });
      }),
      
      // Interval boundaries (vertical lines)
      ...intervals.flatMap((interval, i) => [
        Plot.ruleX([interval.start], {
          stroke: colors[i % colors.length],
          strokeWidth: 2,
          strokeDasharray: "3,2"
        }),
        Plot.ruleX([interval.end], {
          stroke: colors[i % colors.length],
          strokeWidth: 2,
          strokeDasharray: "3,2"
        })
      ]),
      
      // Labels for intervals
      ...intervals.map((interval, i) => {
        const midpoint = (interval.start + interval.end) / 2;
        const yValue = betaPDF(midpoint, betaAlpha, betaBeta);
        return Plot.text([{
          x: midpoint,
          y: yValue,
          text: `C${i + 1}`
        }], {
          x: "x",
          y: "y",
          text: "text",
          dy: -30,
          fontSize: 12,
          fontWeight: "bold",
          fill: colors[i % colors.length]
        });
      })
    ]
  });
  
  // Stats display
  const stats = html`
    <div style="margin-bottom: 15px; padding: 12px; background: var(--header-bg); border-radius: 6px; font-size: 14px;">
      <div style="display: flex; justify-content: space-between; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 20px;">
        <div>
          <strong>Posterior:</strong> Beta(${betaAlpha}, ${betaBeta})
        </div>
        <div>
          <strong>Mean:</strong> ${posteriorMean.toFixed(3)}
        </div>
        <div>
          <strong>Target credibility:</strong> ${((1 - alphaLevel) * 100).toFixed(1)}%
        </div>
        <div>
          <strong>Actual coverage:</strong> ${(totalProb * 100).toFixed(2)}%
        </div>
      </div>
      ${numIntervals > 1 ? html`
        <div style="margin-top: 10px; padding-top: 10px; border-top: 1px solid var(--border);">
          <em style="color: var(--fg-muted);">
            Note: With ${numIntervals} disjoint intervals, the ${((1 - alphaLevel) * 100).toFixed(0)}% 
            probability mass is distributed equally across all intervals, with equal-sized gaps between them.
          </em>
        </div>
      ` : html`
        <div style="margin-top: 10px; padding-top: 10px; border-top: 1px solid var(--border);">
          <em style="color: var(--fg-muted);">
            Note: Single interval uses the equal-tailed credible interval 
            (${(alphaLevel * 50).toFixed(1)}% in each tail).
          </em>
        </div>
      `}
    </div>
  `;
  
  return html`<div style="width: 100%; max-width: 960px; margin: 0 auto;">
    ${stats}
    ${plot}
  </div>`;
}
```

```{ojs}
// Controls with posterior parameter sliders added
viewof credibleControls = {
  const alphaSlider = Inputs.range([0.01, 0.5], { 
    value: 0.05, 
    step: 0.01, 
    label: tex`\alpha` 
  });
  
  const intervalsSlider = Inputs.range([1, 12], { 
    value: 1, 
    step: 1, 
    label: "Number of intervals" 
  });
  
  const betaAlphaSlider = Inputs.range([1, 30], { 
    value: 8, 
    step: 0.5, 
    label: tex`\text{Beta } \alpha \text{ parameter}` 
  });
  
  const betaBetaSlider = Inputs.range([1, 30], { 
    value: 3, 
    step: 0.5, 
    label: tex`\text{Beta } \beta \text{ parameter}` 
  });
  
  const root = html`<details class="controls-root" open>
    <summary style="cursor: pointer; font-weight: 600;">Credible Interval Controls</summary>
    <div class="controls-grid" style="display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr; gap: 20px; padding: 15px;">
      <div class="controls-col">
        <h4 style="margin-bottom: 10px;">Interval Configuration</h4>
        ${alphaSlider}
        <div style="margin-top: 15px;">
          ${intervalsSlider}
        </div>
      </div>
      <div class="controls-col">
        <h4 style="margin-bottom: 10px;">Posterior Parameters</h4>
        ${betaAlphaSlider}
        <div style="margin-top: 15px;">
          ${betaBetaSlider}
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  </details>`;
  
  // Set up value forwarding
  root.value = {
    alpha: alphaSlider.value,
    numIntervals: intervalsSlider.value,
    betaAlpha: betaAlphaSlider.value,
    betaBeta: betaBetaSlider.value
  };
  
  root.addEventListener("input", () => {
    root.value = {
      alpha: alphaSlider.value,
      numIntervals: intervalsSlider.value,
      betaAlpha: betaAlphaSlider.value,
      betaBeta: betaBetaSlider.value
    };
    root.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent("input", { bubbles: true }));
  });
  
  return root;
}

// Reactive bindings
alphaLevel = credibleControls.alpha
numIntervals = credibleControls.numIntervals
betaAlpha = credibleControls.betaAlpha
betaBeta = credibleControls.betaBeta
```
